dialogue_pages.speaker: guard
dialogue_pages.text: Regent Aldric. We were beginning to watch for you.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Regent Aldric. We were beginning to watch for you.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: Have we kept you long?
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Have we kept you long?

dialogue_pages.speaker: guard
dialogue_pages.text: Only since the last wagon came in. You came by the ridge road, my lord?
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Only since the last wagon came in. You came by the ridge road, my lord?

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: We did. Your warning reached us before the turning.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: We did. Your warning reached us before the turning.

dialogue_pages.speaker: guard
dialogue_pages.text: A longer journey, then.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: A longer journey, then.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: *with a tired smile* A better one than finding the crossing ourselves.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: *with a tired smile* A better one than finding the crossing ourselves.

dialogue_pages.speaker: guard
dialogue_pages.text: The approach is clear. Mother Serene is expecting you.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: The approach is clear. Mother Serene is expecting you.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: Thank you. And keep someone at the barrier. We can find our way from here.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Thank you. And keep someone at the barrier. We can find our way from here.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: My lord? A moment, if you can spare it.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: My lord? A moment, if you can spare it.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: Of course.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Of course.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: They said you were coming to look at the road. Are they saying when we'll have our bridge back?
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: They said you were coming to look at the road. Are they saying when we'll have our bridge back?

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: Not yet. I need to see what the crews are working with before I give you a date.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Not yet. I need to see what the crews are working with before I give you a date.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: *lets out a frustrated breath* We've had enough dates already.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: *lets out a frustrated breath* We've had enough dates already.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: Then I won't give you another one today.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Then I won't give you another one today.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: It's the hauling. Every load takes longer, and there are fewer carts to share.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: It's the hauling. Every load takes longer, and there are fewer carts to share.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: What has been getting through?
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: What has been getting through?

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: Some supplies. Enough lamp oil for the festival, at least. It's the next few loads I'm worried about.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Some supplies. Enough lamp oil for the festival, at least. It's the next few loads I'm worried about.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: Were you here when it happened?
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Were you here when it happened?

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: *quietly* I saw the flash from the fields. By the time I reached the bank, the middle of the bridge was gone.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: *quietly* I saw the flash from the fields. By the time I reached the bank, the middle of the bridge was gone.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: It had split the road on both sides. Stone all over the water.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: It had split the road on both sides. Stone all over the water.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: We've seen damage like this elsewhere. I wish I could tell you why.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: We've seen damage like this elsewhere. I wish I could tell you why.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: Elsewhere? I thought we had been unlucky.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Elsewhere? I thought we had been unlucky.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: So did the people I visited before coming here. There have been a few such incidents.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: So did the people I visited before coming here. There have been a few such incidents.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: And every place needs the same stone and carts.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: And every place needs the same stone and carts.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: *nods* Yes. That's part of what I've come to discuss.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: *nods* Yes. That's part of what I've come to discuss.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: Tell my clerk which deliveries are waiting. The crew needs to know what people are still trying to get through.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Tell my clerk which deliveries are waiting. The crew needs to know what people are still trying to get through.

dialogue_pages.speaker: clerk
dialogue_pages.text: I can take that down now.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: I can take that down now.

dialogue_pages.speaker: local
dialogue_pages.text: Thank you. I know ours isn't the only road.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Thank you. I know ours isn't the only road.

dialogue_pages.speaker: aldric
dialogue_pages.text: It's still the one you need. Thank you for stopping me.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: It's still the one you need. Thank you for stopping me.

dialogue_pages.speaker: serene
dialogue_pages.text: He's had little rest between these visits.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: He's had little rest between these visits.

dialogue_pages.speaker: serene
dialogue_pages.text: I wish I had a simpler answer for him.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: I wish I had a simpler answer for him.

dialogue_pages.speaker: tomas
dialogue_pages.text: Mother? Are these enough cups?
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Mother? Are these enough cups?

dialogue_pages.speaker: serene
dialogue_pages.text: *turns back to him* Bring two more, love.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: *turns back to him* Bring two more, love.

dialogue_pages.speaker: tomas
dialogue_pages.text: Two more. Right.
dialogue_pages.source_paragraph: Two more. Right.

trace_sampling: 2Hz plus shot entries; 10Hz during pan; all 24 pan frames separately retained

sequence.scope: Entire last locals question, all pan frames, both complete bridge paragraphs, entire relief phase

clerk_observation.method: Read-only wrapper around the production _frame return Surface; identity-matched runtime loop index

render_input_scope: Only actually executed production Python and actually read runtime asset JSON/PNG; no reviews, authoring inputs or self-report
known_limitations: Headless music is reconstructed from commands, not hardware loopback; effects intentionally absent.
One final normal-world draw is recorded; no normal-world simulation update is run after handoff.
The normal seen handoff restages Serene/Tomas and reveals the visitors; these changes are reported separately from the strictly frozen active cinematic.
Clerk crop panels are nearest-neighbor enlargements of actual in-game frames, not isolated sprite renders.
This capture is not the broader test suite. Parent edits to recorded inputs require recapture.
